Great to hear the scale numbers — that’s the level where we typically recommend a committed tier to get predictable unit economics. I attached our public Q4 rate card for reference (redwood_ratecard_Q4.pdf).

Team —

Quick notes after reviewing Sara's numbers and the draft SOW:
- Proposed commit: 12 months, 600B tokens/month baseline (annual commitment = 7.2T tokens).
- Suggested commercial: deliver 12% off list per-token for months 1–6, then 5% off list months 7–12. This balances ramp support with margin recovery.
- Overage: bill at list rate with a 3% uplift on the committed rate if sustained >20% above commit for a full billing quarter.
- Data: require usage reporting cadence (monthly) and a hard cap change policy to protect capacity.

Attachments for pricing review: redwood_ratecard_Q4.pdf (public) + Nimbus_SOW_v1.pdf (customer). I can pull usage histogram if needed.

Marcus
Account Executive — Strategic Sales

Laura / Marcus / Aisha —

Thanks for the context and the draft guardrails. High-level position from pricing/finance:
- 12% off list for months 1–6 is above the standard approval threshold for AE-level signoff. This requires a formal pricing exception (pricing_approval_form.xlsx) and my sign-off plus finance review.
- We prefer a structure that ties the concession to conservative commit confirmation: e.g., signed 12-mo MSA + 30% of first quarter invoiced upfront or a partial prepayment to protect cash if they under-deliver.
- The proposed overage language is acceptable but change the enforcement to: if usage exceeds commit by >25% for any quarter, we trigger a re-evaluation and potential rate adjustment (instead of automatic uplift). Legal will prefer a re-evaluation clause to automatic surcharges.

If Marcus can get Nimbus to accept (a) MSA signature and (b) 30% initial payment or 3-month prepay, I can provisionally approve the 12%/5% split for months 1–6 / 7–12. Otherwise recommend sliding concession to 10%/4% to stay in AE-authorized range.

I attached pricing_approval_form.xlsx for the exception workflow. Please get Nimbus' procurement to confirm payment terms and we’ll route for final finance/legal review.

-Aditya
Head of Pricing & Revenue Ops
